claims: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The SLS rocket carried Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen into Earth orbit.
The NASA Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
According to The New York Times and CNN, the Orion capsule is currently in high Earth orbit following a "picture-perfect" launch.
The crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The NASA Artemis II mission marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
According to BBC, the crew is set to perform maneuvers to travel toward the moon, test systems, and orbit the far side.
The NASA Artemis II mission will test Orion's systems with a crew on board before future Artemis moon landings.
